fullTextZH: 大家都说去瑞士是他们的梦想
fullTextEN: Everyone says going to Switzerland is their dream.

fullTextZH: 中国人对外国人太好了
fullTextEN: Chinese people are very nice to foreigners.

fullTextZH: 我不管外国人喜欢吃什么
fullTextEN: I don't care what foreigners like to eat.
What I like to eat is most important.

fullTextZH: 你们知道我的男朋友是白人
fullTextEN: You know my boyfriend is white.
I have brought him to China four times.

fullTextZH: 我发现中国人对外国人真的非常好
fullTextEN: I found that Chinese people are really very nice to foreigners.
Nice to the point that it annoys me.

fullTextZH: 服务员都会站在餐厅的外面
fullTextEN: The waiters all stand outside the restaurant.
And say to everyone, come, come, come.
Come to our place to eat.
Our food is the most delicious.

fullTextZH: 我们看到了一家西安菜
fullTextEN: We saw a Xi'an cuisine restaurant.
I think it should be delicious.
Come to our house for a meal.
We have a lot of delicious food.

fullTextZH: 外国人最喜欢吃我们家的牛肉哦
fullTextEN: Foreigners love our family's beef the most.

fullTextZH: 外国人最喜欢吃这道菜
fullTextEN: Foreigners love this dish the most.

fullTextZH: 我那个时候就突然生气了
fullTextEN: I suddenly got angry at that time.

fullTextZH: 我不管外国人喜欢吃什么
fullTextEN: I don't care what foreigners like to eat.
What I like to eat is most important.

fullTextZH: 外国人最喜欢我们家的餐厅啦
fullTextEN: Foreigners love our family's restaurant the most.
You should come to our house to eat.

fullTextZH: 你知不知道我跟旁边这个外国人
fullTextEN: Do you know about me and this foreigner next to me?

fullTextZH: 在家里我就是他的女王
fullTextEN: At home, I am his queen.

fullTextZH: 我不高兴他也不会好过的
fullTextEN: If I'm unhappy, he won't have it easy either.

fullTextZH: 那当然我只是想了一下啊
fullTextEN: Of course, I was just thinking for a moment.

fullTextZH: 我也没有想到要这么跟她说嘛
fullTextEN: I also didn't think to tell her like that.

fullTextZH: 我就带着我男朋友去旁边的餐厅
fullTextEN: I just took my boyfriend to the nearby restaurant.

fullTextZH: 那我想在这里没有人跟我说
fullTextEN: Then I thought no one here would tell me.

fullTextZH: 我男朋友说他想去厕所
fullTextEN: My boyfriend said he wants to go to the bathroom.
I just looked at the menu for a moment.

fullTextZH: 突然那个服务员跑过来

fullTextEN: He ran over to tell me.

fullTextZH: 刚才那个外国人走错了
fullTextEN: That foreigner just now went the wrong way.

fullTextZH: 你能不能跟他说厕所不在那边
fullTextEN: Can you tell him the restroom is not over there?
It's okay, he has Google Maps.

fullTextZH: 外国人他用谷歌地图用得更好
fullTextEN: Foreigners use Google Maps even better.

fullTextZH: 我男朋友这个外国人很好
fullTextEN: My boyfriend, this foreigner, is very nice.

fullTextZH: 这两个星期我住在我爸妈家
fullTextEN: I've been staying at my parents' house for the past two weeks.

fullTextZH: 我爸妈对这个外国人都特别照顾
fullTextEN: My parents take special care of this foreigner.
My mom asks me every day
Is Oskar getting used to it?
One day I saw my mom

fullTextZH: 在准备我最喜欢吃的水果

fullTextEN: My mom also glanced at me
She walked past me holding the fruit

fullTextZH: 把我最喜欢的水果拿给我男朋友吃
fullTextEN: And gave my favorite fruit to my boyfriend to eat

fullTextZH: 一边给他水果一边拍拍他说
fullTextEN: While giving him fruit, she patted him and said
Oskar, you should drink more hot water.

fullTextZH: 有一次我坐在沙发上嘛
fullTextEN: Once I was sitting on the sofa

fullTextZH: 我妈妈看到了她就对我说
fullTextEN: My mom saw it and said to me
If you eat Oskar again, there will be none left.

fullTextZH: 那我的男朋友当然很开心啦
fullTextEN: Then of course my boyfriend is very happy.
Because everyone is very nice to him.

fullTextZH: 大家都说去瑞士是他们的梦想
fullTextEN: Everyone says going to Switzerland is their dream.

fullTextZH: 中国人对外国人太好了
fullTextEN: Chinese people are too nice to foreigners.

fullTextZH: 有时候我看到他高兴的样子
fullTextEN: Sometimes I see him looking happy.

fullTextZH: 我都希望有不好的事情发生
fullTextEN: I always hope something bad happens.
I think maybe I'm too bad.

fullTextZH: 那天我们两个回到中国
fullTextEN: That day, the two of us returned to China.
We needed to go through customs at the airport.

fullTextZH: 一般是你要去另外一个国家
fullTextEN: Usually, you need to go to another country.
There are customs at the airport.
They will look at your passport.

fullTextZH: 问你来这个国家做什么
fullTextEN: They ask you what you are doing in this country.
We need to go through Chinese customs.
It's very easy for me to enter China.
There are many machines at customs.
I went through Chinese customs in two minutes.
I waited for him at that place.

fullTextZH: 要去另一个地方要排队
fullTextEN: He needs to go to another place and queue.

fullTextZH: 他的前面有很多外国人嘛
fullTextEN: In front of him, there are many foreigners, right?

fullTextZH: 我看他好像在想什么事情
fullTextEN: I think he seems to be thinking about something.
The customs officer then asked him.
What are you coming to China for?
How long will you stay in China?
Where will you live in China?

fullTextZH: 我就看他一直在努力地用中文
fullTextEN: I just saw him constantly trying to use Chinese.

fullTextZH: 我看他看起来有一点紧张
fullTextEN: I saw he looked a bit nervous.
This customs officer is very nice.

fullTextZH: 那这个海关人员继续问问题
fullTextEN: Then this customs officer continued asking questions.

fullTextZH: 我男朋友就看了一下我嘛
fullTextEN: My boyfriend just glanced at me.

fullTextZH: 海关人员也看了一下我
fullTextEN: The customs officer also glanced at me.

fullTextZH: 他说你女朋友是中国人是吧
fullTextEN: He said, 'Your girlfriend is Chinese, right?'
You came to China with her.

fullTextZH: 海关工作人员是不是很喜欢你
fullTextEN: Do customs officers really like you?

fullTextZH: 海关人员有没有告诉你
fullTextEN: Did the customs officer tell you?

fullTextZH: 去瑞士是她最大的梦想啊
fullTextEN: Going to Switzerland is her biggest dream.

fullTextZH: 那天呢我在海关等了他30分钟
fullTextEN: That day, I waited for him at customs for 30 minutes.

fullTextZH: 每一分钟我都非常快乐
fullTextEN: Every minute I was very happy.

fullTextZH: 看到他在中国也有不容易的时候
fullTextEN: I saw that he also had difficult times in China.
